about.title: Why Does This Page Exist?
about.intro: This isn't a template. It's a showcase — engineered by a QA Specialist and weekend Artisan. If your portfolio was built with a drag-and-drop builder... we should talk.
about.aboutme_leader_p: I build automation frameworks with an entrepreneurial mindset—focusing on maintainability, ROI, and full user journeys. My leadership philosophy: Slow is smooth, smooth is fast, and relentless momentum gets it done. Trust is good; empowering a team is better.
about.aboutme_artisan_p: Digital frameworks require logic, but my physical crafts keep my hands grounded. I still use the very first welding machine I ever bought, mastering the raw, pragmatic art of electrode welding. Alongside managing three beehives at my vineyard, I brew craft beer on 50L equipment I engineered from scratch.
about.aboutme_father_p: I bake sourdough using spent brewing grains with my kids helping. I'm teaching them capability and the maker's rule: 'Measure twice, cut once.'
about.stack_ai: 🤖 Built with AI-assisted development (Antigravity + Chrome MCP)
about.stack_arch: 🏗️ React + TypeScript + Vite — zero Tailwind, pure CSS craftsmanship
about.stack_deploy: 🚀 Auto-deploys via Vercel on every git push
about.stack_testing: ✅ Self-testing: ESLint (WCAG 2.2), Prettier, Vitest, Playwright E2E
about.stack_a11y: ♿ Accessibility-first: semantic HTML, ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, jsx-a11y linting
about.cta_text: I am in a position I truly enjoy, collaborating across multiple teams to architect state-of-the-art QA structures. My current company provides excellent challenges and a strong foundation for continuous learning. However, I am always open to a conversation if you are offering an outstanding opportunity.
about.atlas_teaser: Why I left legacy SaaS behind: a Git-versioned, agent-readable QA Assistant I designed and built.
about.atlas_problem: 📉 The Legacy Bottleneck: Traditional QA SaaS isolates test definitions from product requirements, trapping engineers in endless manual documentation rather than ensuring quality.
about.atlas_pattern: 🏗️ The Autonomous Pattern: I abandoned legacy SaaS for Git-versioned Markdown. By wiring Jira, Figma, and Google Workspace directly into a continuous MCP loop, my framework acts as a full-fledged AI QA Assistant—syncing meetings, auto-drafting test cases, and instantly documenting system knowledge.
about.atlas_outcome: ✅ Outcome: 1,800+ test cases live natively in Git. AI proactively manages test creation and auto-syncs QA knowledge, directly improving daily QA life.
about.how_i_work_header: QA engineer building the AI tooling layer for test infrastructure. I replaced a legacy test management SaaS with a Git-versioned, AI-readable system I designed and built myself.
about.how_i_work_intro: I don't just adopt AI; I architect production-ready, multi-agent frameworks that redefine how tech is built and tested:
about.how_i_work_antigravity: 🤖 Antigravity (Chrome MCP): Powers this portfolio using a strictly routed, multi-skill agentic architecture for zero-defect, rapid deployment.
about.how_i_work_claude: 🧠 Claude Code (CLI): The cognitive engine behind my QA infrastructure, automating complex terminal operations and orchestrating local toolchains.
about.playwright_p1: This page is guarded by Playwright E2E tests that use data-testid selectors, auto-waiting, and retry logic — no brittle CSS selectors, no sleep hacks. Here's how to run them:
about.playwright_p2: Every test targets semantic HTML and data attributes, making them resilient to visual redesigns. The suite runs against localhost:5173 and covers critical user journeys across all viewports.
